newsitem.title: JAPAN: Showa Shell says may merge refining unit.
newsitem.headline: Showa Shell says may merge refining unit.

text.p: Showa Shell Sekiyu KK said on Monday that it is considering merging its oil refining and distribution divisions with Mitsubishi Oil Co Ltd"s refining division.
"But no final agreement has been reached," a Showa Shell official said.
"We have been exchanging information with Mitsubishi Oil on have in mind," Mitsuaki Nabetani, managing director of Showa Shell, told reporters.
He said Showa Shell is already cooperating with Mitsubishi Oil in some fields such as sharing oil tanks.
"We have already been cooperating with Mitsubishi Oil in such fields as oil distribution and we are now studying if we can expand this cooperation further," he said.
He also said Mitsubishi Oil has been the only company with which it has been negotiating on a possible merger, but added that it would still leave its options open.
The financial situation of Japanese oil companies has dramatically worsened since the deregulation of oil product imports last April.
